references.text: The original dream that Pharaoh recounts in verse 18. Verse 2 uses almost identical language about seven fat cows coming up from the Nile and grazing among the reeds.
Pharaoh's dream of the seven fat and seven lean cows, which is the direct account that Pharaoh recounts from verse 17.
Joseph's interpretation of the dream: the seven fat cows are seven years of plenty, and the seven lean cows are seven years of famine.
Joseph explicitly describes the seven years of great abundance in Egypt, followed by seven years of famine—the fulfillment of the dream's meaning.
